blocks.title: 📰 2. 🏛️ REGULATORY BODIES NEWS
blocks.text: 🪝 SEBI Report: Unclaimed Mutual Fund Amounts Reach ₹3,811 Crore as of March 2026. Key development for Banking & General Awareness.

items: Unclaimed mutual fund dividends rose 15.7% to ₹2,689 crore, bringing total unclaimed MF pool to ₹3,811 crore.
**Unclaimed Breakdown:** Unclaimed dividends rose 15.7% to **₹2,689 crore**; unclaimed redemption fell 0.5% to **₹1,122 crore**.
**Total Unclaimed Pool:** Stood at **₹3,811 crore** as of March 31, 2026.
**Remedial Measures:** Centralised nominee reporting with KRA, DigiLocker access, and 'Niveshak Shivir' drive by SEBI + IEPFA.
⚠️ **Direction Trap:** Unclaimed dividends INCREASED by 15.7%, whereas unclaimed redemption DECREASED by 0.5%.
🎯 Exam Angle → Focus on statutory circular guidelines, compliance deadlines, penal provisions, and applicability thresholds across scheduled banks.
